title: Body fat calculator: U.S. Navy method
description: Estimate your body fat percentage from neck, waist and hip measurements using the U.S. Navy method, plus fat mass and lean body mass.

errors.waistNeck: Your waist must be larger than your neck — check the measurements.
errors.girthNeck: Waist plus hips must be larger than your neck — check the measurements.
errors.outOfRange: These measurements give an impossible result — check that they’re all in the same units and taken as described.
